subject: general
question: Janak started from his office and after travelling a distance of 4 km towards north, he turned to the left and travelled a distance of 3 km. He then tuned left and travelled 9 km. He then took a final left, travelled 3 km and stopped. What is the shortest distance between the stopping point and his office? (All tums are 90 degree turns only)
solution: Given:- 1) Janak started from his office and traveled a distance of 4 km towards north. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d05a526ede0752185b6eba909413c66db04b2b639a6694cfbd4790b5b2eb472.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3431ea6e6d08ccddde3e1444eaeca194053cc13781af97a9056cc9ab39b4995.png] 2) He then turned left and traveled a distance of 3 km.
